title: No repeat without new evidence (anchor-based suppression)
description:
In context_packs: record the pack anchor (thread id, concept key; later hub lineage, component fingerprint) on the idea via generated.evidence. Offer the same anchor again only when exceeds_report(new_window, reported_window) says the activity is materially more than the last idea reported, OR the pack has at least one accepted Reference not in the last pack. A spiked idea's anchor needs both. A Reference may appear in several theme ideas. Log packsSkippedNoNewEvidence.
Tests + Gherkin scenario: an anchor already drafted yields nothing without new evidence; with new evidence it yields a new pack; a spiked anchor needs both conditions.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
